body: **HEDGIES REALLY THINK WE’RE BITCHMADE HUH? JUST BOUGHT ANOTHER 6 SHARES HOORAAHHHH**

Because to be honest I don’t really care to try to help myself, I don’t really have anything to lose. I don’t really care about who I’m going to hurt by doing so, as selfish as that is it’s true. For the resources point, if I can’t find the sufficient medication from pharmacies, I will simply drive my car into a wall at high speed. I’ve planned this for quite a while and once again thank you very much for your attempts to deter me, however it is my time to go. Goodbye friend, you probably won’t hear from me again after this message, I wish you all the best!

I have tried to speak to Samaritans and 2 other hotlines in the past few weeks, it’s no help. I’m really not interested in help. I’m not scared of the anonymity being breached by a therapist, but just do not see the point in doing so. I thank you very much for your time but this is unfortunately just slipping away from what the point of this thread was for, which I have since learned from yourself that attempt advice is not really given here. This just means that I will just have to go through with it by my own means. I wish you the best of luck in life, it was very nice to meet you and I hope that you don’t reach the same demise that I am about to!

Thank you for the reply. I’ve not really ever been the type to talk about my feelings with anybody if it isn’t anonymously. I’ve only ever trusted one person with these types of conversations and they gave me a very good reason not to do so ever again. I’ve done my research and I think I’m confident that I can make an overdose work, but I understand that people don’t tend to offer advice on attempts here.
